annotations.text: SCOPE, 2 Sep 2026. This canvas is the DIAGRAM layer of Midnight Everyman / Hidden Systems, repo C:\\Users\\dicku\\Videos\\midnight-everyman. House Style Bible v2 (everyman_bible_v2/) is authoritative for the Observer, palette and texture - this canvas now uses its hexes and Courier Prime. Subject selection, thumbnail and packaging sheets were retired here; they live in docs/01-product/ and docs/02-creative/.

1920x1080 at 24 fps, 5-8 minutes, 300-480 s (7200-11520 frames). Frame rate is 24, not 30: see docs/01-product/format.md. Every motion value on sheet 06 is a whole frame count because Remotion is frame-based - the old millisecond figures landed on fractional frames and would silently round. Cadence is UNDECIDED until the pilot is timed.

Reference lineage: Eames, A Communications Primer (1953) - Herbert Bayer, World Geo-Graphic Atlas (1953) - Ladislav Sutnar, Catalog Design Progress - Erik Nitsche's General Dynamics series (1955). All explanatory diagramming. The character layer draws on UPA-era limited animation instead; the two meet at the palette.

Read order: rules (01) -> palette, line grammar, type -> frame + motion + frame device -> beats -> worked episode -> ideation (10) -> script (11). Three hard gates admit a subject - touched, opaque, packageable - and they live in docs/01-product/subject-selection.md, not here. Everyman is not in the frame layout: he replaces the whole composition at the open and close.
